name: modernize-package-and-sdk-baseline
prompt: Stabilize an existing .NET 10 WPF repository whose SDK and package versions drift across developer machines and offline factory deployments.
rubric: Inspects global.json, central package management, lock or restore behavior, and offline package sources.
Avoids inventing package versions and requires verification from official metadata or the repository.
Defines a reproducible restore and rollback strategy for developer and factory environments.
